source.author: verg
source.text: Agnovit longe gemitum praesaga mali mens:
source.text_original: Agnovit longe gemitum praesaga mali mens: /
source.text_english: His foreknowing mind recognized from afar the groan of impending misfortune.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Statimque mens mali praesaga, putare coepit dominum meditari mortem, solem cernere nigrescentem.
reuse.text_original: Statimque mens mali praesaga, putare coepit dominum meditari mortem, solem cernere nigrescentem.
reuse.text_english: And immediately, his mind, foreboding evil, began to think that his master was planning his death, seeing the sun grow dark.
